title: A functor with an exact left adjoint preserves injectives
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma relates three conditions on an adjoint pair of additive functors between abelian categories, namely that the left adjoint preserves monomorphisms, that it is exact, and that the right adjoint preserves injectives, and shows that the first two are equivalent and imply the third, with all three equivalent when the source has enough injectives (statement lines 7486-7502). The proof is a complete argument: the first equivalence is reduced to right exactness of a left adjoint together with the characterization of exactness (proof lines 7505-7507); the implication to preservation of injectives is a two-step adjointness computation with the extension property (proof lines 7509-7520); and the converse uses enough injectives and the extension property in the target category (proof lines 7522-7528). The non-formal content is the adjointness bookkeeping in the two implications. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
